_meta.purpose: AUDIO-VERIFICATION WORKLIST for cronologia/olavo#2: candidate quotations from the COF community transcriptions. Nothing here may enter philosopher pages or the chronology until checked against the audio.

sources.taskA_selection: top aula per philosopher from /workspace/olavo/data/cof-reception.json (topAulas by word-boundary hits)
sources.taskB_selection: /home/user/archive/webcaptures/cof-autobio-testimony.json (397-entry autobiographical index); the 12 aulas named in the ticket, one snippet each, extended to a natural quotable span

_meta.verified: all 32 literal - every quote is a byte-exact, accent-exact substring of its file at the stated charOffset (Python str.find on the UTF-8 decoded text; charOffset is a character offset, not a byte offset), and each occurs exactly once in its file
_meta.charOffsetNote: charOffset counts Unicode characters from the start of the file (Python string indexing). For byte offsets re-encode the prefix as UTF-8.
_meta.audio: Aula audio lives in the public COFemAudio collection on archive.org, one file per aula; audioHint gives the zero-padded aula ID (e.g. COF076) to find the file fast. TIMESTAMPS CANNOT BE COMPUTED FROM TEXT: the transcriptions carry only sparse [hh:mm] markers, so the listener must locate each passage by ear; the [hh:mm] markers nearest the offset can narrow the search but are not part of this worklist.
_meta.status: every entry is status UNVERIFIED-PENDING-AUDIO: quotes are faithful to the transcription, but the transcription itself (especially revisao_pendente files COF324, COF328, COF370, COF426, COF507) may mishear Olavo - e.g. 'Chuom'/'Shouon' for Schuon, 'Atarica' for tariqa. Audio check must confirm wording before any dataset use.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Tudo o que o Popper escreveu é três linhas da dialética de Aristóteles.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Dismissing the cult of Popper's falsifiability as the summit of scientific methodology: for Olavo it is a tiny fragment of Aristotle's dialectic.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Signature reduction of a modern icon to a footnote of Aristotle; maximally quotable.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Eu não fiz nada mais do que dizer que Aristóteles tinha uma teoria que ele não expôs, e daí eu expus com as minhas pobres palavras.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Explaining how he derived his Theory of the Four Discourses: it is Aristotle's own unexposed theory, merely articulated by Olavo.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Defines Olavo's self-declared relation to Aristotle - the source of his best-known theory.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Podemos perguntar por que Descartes teria necessidade de se esconder precisamente no momento em que está se mostrando. Para que subir à cena do mundo se é para se esconder ao mesmo tempo?
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Opening of the 'mascaramento de Descartes' lecture: Descartes' motto larvatus prodeo (I advance masked) poses the riddle of why a philosopher hides while going public.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: The core formulation of the 'mascaramento de Descartes' thesis the task explicitly asks for.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Descartes elimina a Providência: Deus criou o mundo e não interfere mais a partir daí.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Arguing that Descartes covertly replaced the Christian God with a deist mechanic, a conception that silently became the popular notion of God.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: One-sentence verdict on what the Cartesian mask concealed; ideal companion to the mask quote.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Platão é de certo modo o modelo de todos os filósofos
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Presenting Plato's biography as the exemplary case in which every stage of the philosophical method is visible.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Shortest possible statement of Plato's rank in Olavo's canon.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: O Platão é, na verdade, o criador do método filosófico. O criador não só teórico, com prático
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Concluding the lecture: Plato's life exemplifies all seven stages of what Olavo calls the philosophical method, which Plato both created and practiced.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Memorable strong claim - Plato as inventor of the philosophical method itself (transcription unrevised, 'com'='como').

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Simplesmente a mente revolucionária é assim: inverte o sujeito e o objeto.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Analyzing Marx's claim that labor defines value as a case of 'cognitive parallax': the revolutionary mind swaps subject and object on nearly every page of O Capital.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Compact statement of Olavo's 'paralaxe cognitiva' diagnosis of Marx.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Karl Marx não, é macumba no todo e nos detalhes.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Contrasting Hegel (sorcery in the whole but brilliant in the parts, per Voegelin) with Marx, whose work Olavo calls sorcery in whole and in detail.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: The single most quotable Olavo verdict on Marx in the corpus.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: o problema mais grave da conduta moral não é você conhecer a doutrina, não é você conhecer o certo e o errado, mas você preencher o hiato entre o fato concreto e a doutrina geral
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Citing Aquinas against doctrinaire moralism: doctrine can never bridge the gap between the concrete fact and the general rule for you.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Shows how Olavo reads Aquinas as anti-systemic - the hiato is a recurring Olavo motif.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: o próprio Santo Tomás que dizia que "a verdade é filha do tempo". Se a verdade é filha do tempo quer dizer que precisa continuar procurando, então nunca ninguém completa
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Against Carlos Nougué's picture of Thomism as a finished deductive system, Olavo turns Aquinas' own dictum 'truth is the daughter of time' against closed Thomism.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Aquinas quoted against the Thomists - a signature Olavo move in his polemic with Nougué.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Kant não é somente um filósofo acadêmico, dedicado a questões técnicas, mas é efetivamente o ideólogo de um movimento político de longuíssimo alcance
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Thesis of the whole Kant cycle: Kant's technical philosophy must be subordinated to his Enlightenment world-project centered on transforming religion.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: The programmatic sentence of Olavo's reinterpretation of Kant.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: a operação bélica que ele move contra a metafísica é tão fraca, tão frágil, tão furada, que eu acho incrível que alguém tenha levado isto a sério por mais de meia hora
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Countering the manual clichés that Kant demonstrated the impossibility of metaphysics: metaphysics kept being written as if nothing had happened.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Peak Olavo polemical style applied to the Critique of Pure Reason; highly memorable.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: A diferença específica entre Sócrates e os pretensos sábios da cidade era que Sócrates tinha o mapa da ignorância, ou seja, ele sabia o que perguntar.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Commenting the Apologia: Socratic wisdom is not knowledge but a precisely delineated ignorance that generates the right questions.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: The 'mapa da ignorância' is Olavo's signature coinage for Socrates.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: odiavam Sócrates pelo simples fato de que essas pessoas tinham se sentido humilhadas. Ou seja: não por causa de alguma doutrina que Sócrates pregasse e que fosse contrária às convicções deles, porque Sócrates não pregava absolutamente nada.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Explaining the trial: decades of wounded vanity among the 'talking classes', not any doctrine, produced the accusation - Socrates preached nothing.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Reads the trial of Socrates through Olavo's favorite lens of cultural hegemony and resentment.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Agora, aos 66 anos, talvez eu já esteja um homenzinho e esteja pronto para tratar desses assuntos e começar uma espécie de acerto de contas com René Guénon.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Opening his first public critical examination of Guénon after decades of deliberate silence about his tradicionalist years.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Announces the 'acerto de contas' with Guénon - doubly valuable as reception and autobiography.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: é preciso ser extremamente burro para não perceber que a obra inteira de René Guénon tem este objetivo: a islamização do Ocidente.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Conclusion of his reading of Guénon's 'action tradicionnelle': behind the metaphysics lay a concrete program of Islamic occupation of the West.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: The bluntest formulation of Olavo's mature verdict on Guénon.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Tomada como um modelo analógico, a filosofia inteira de Hegel é absolutamente genial; só que ela não é verdadeira, é apenas um símbolo.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Arguing there are two ways to read Hegel: as the most brilliant fiction ever written, or literally - and only the first is legitimate.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Olavo's complete Hegel-formula in one sentence: genial as analogy, false as truth.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: Essa é a grande descoberta de Hegel: só existe verdade no todo; a verdade *é* o todo, e o todo só pode ser concebido sob a forma de um sistema
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Granting Hegel his 'terribly true' starting point against Kant's regionalization of knowledge, before showing why the system cannot close.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: The generous half of Olavo's Hegel assessment - pairs with the 'modelo analógico' verdict.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: o Louis Lavelle encarna de uma das maneiras mais perfeitas a noção mesma do que é um filósofo.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Closing the Lavelle cycle: unlike lovers of abstract argument, Lavelle never loses the tension between the act of thought and the presence of being.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Olavo's highest praise of his favorite modern philosopher, in one line.

taskA_philosopherQuotes.quote: O sujeito que foi chamado o Platão do nosso tempo, eu digo: onde vai enquadrar o Platão senão no platonismo? Então o Lavelle só pode ser classificado no lavellismo.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.context: Answering whether Lavelle is an existentialist: he is unclassifiable, a school unto himself.
taskA_philosopherQuotes.whyThisQuote: Carries the 'Platão do nosso tempo' epithet plus the witty 'lavellismo' coinage.

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: logo que eu nasci, eu fiquei doente por sete anos, na cama, praticamente sem me mover, com febre o tempo todo, delirando. Eu sarei repentinamente, ninguém sabe por que eu estava doente e ninguém sabe por que eu sarei.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: Biographical retrospect: seven bedridden years of fever and delirium from birth, then a sudden unexplained recovery, straight to school feeling like an 'ET'.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: Fullest first-person account of the childhood illness in the corpus.

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: A minha própria vida é um milagre, porque eu nasci com um tumor na traquéia do tamanho de uma laranja.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: While discussing miracles he offers his own life: a congenital tracheal tumor the size of an orange, never diagnosed, still there at 62.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: Anchors the congenital-illness event with the vivid orange-sized-tumor detail.

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: fui trabalhar no jornalismo por um único motivo: naquela época a lei determinava um período de cinco horas para o trabalho jornalístico e eu achei aquilo uma maravilha porque precisava de tempo sobrando para estudar.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: At seventeen, after office-boy jobs, he entered journalism solely because the five-hour legal workday left time to study.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: Gives the stated motive for the journalism career the chronology dates to c. 1964-65.

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: "Pelo menos tenho que arrumar alguma encrenca" --- pensei. Foi aí que eu entrei para o partido comunista, para arrumar encrenca.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: Recalling that at ~15 he wanted to be a writer, had no life experience, and joined the Communist Party 'to get into trouble'.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: The canonical self-explanation for joining the PCB, in his own words.

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: Naqueles anos em que estive ali, li um monte de obras de Karl Marx, de Lênin, da tal Escola de Frankfurt quase inteira, um monte de coisas de Georg Lukács, e eu estava levando aquilo a sério.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: Detailing his PCB militancy: unlike student leaders Rui Falcão and José Dirceu, he actually read the Marxist corpus seriously.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: Documents the depth of the Marxist formation during the PCB years.

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: eu montei uma escola, que era a Escola Júpiter, onde dava cursos de astrologia, de simbolismo, religiões comparadas, de arte, etc.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: After selling his share in a bookstore co-owned with Luiz Pellegrini, he founded Escola Júpiter with teachers like Dora Ferreira da Silva, closing it around 1980.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: Names the Escola Júpiter, the institutional anchor of the astrology era.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.chronologyEvent: astrology-era: founds Escola Júpiter (mid-1970s, closed c. 1980)

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: eu pratiquei astrologia profissionalmente durante dois anos para ter gente, ter amostragem
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: Explaining his 'astrocaracterologia': he practiced astrology professionally for two years to build a live sample, interpreting some 5,000 charts.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: Quantifies the professional astrology phase (two years) directly from testimony.

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: Dating his personal acquaintance with Frithjof Schuon ('Chuom' in this unrevised transcription) while criticizing Schuon's lack of human discernment.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: The only explicit self-dated year for meeting Schuon in the corpus.

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: O fato mesmo de eu ter saído de lá, expulso da tariqa, por eu brigar com o xeique, para eles não significa nada. Estou na tariqa durante um ano e meio
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: Answering critics (Velasco, padre Kramer) who paint his tariqa period as militancy: he was there a year and a half and left expelled after quarreling with the sheikh.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: States both the duration (1.5 years) and the mode of exit (expulsion) of the tariqa period.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.chronologyEvent: tariqa: 1.5 years, expelled after quarrel with the sheikh (mid-1980s)

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: Eu comecei a enviar piada, mal criada para ele até que um dia funcionou. Ele me expulsou da Atarica
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: Since one cannot leave a tariqa, he engineered his own expulsion by sending Schuon rude joke letters until it worked ('Atarica' = tariqa in this raw transcription).
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: The vivid mechanism of the tariqa exit, complementing the COF242 duration testimony.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.chronologyEvent: tariqa: engineers his own expulsion via joke letters (late 1980s)

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: o meu confessor pessoal, que é o Padre Paulo Ricardo de Azevedo, ele mesmo frequentemente se considera desqualificado para julgar o trabalho filosófico que nós estamos fazendo.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: Arguing that philosophical investigation cannot be pre-submitted to clerical judgment; even his own confessor humbly declines that role.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: Names Padre Paulo Ricardo as his personal confessor, as of 2010.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.chronologyEvent: confessor: Padre Paulo Ricardo de Azevedo as personal confessor (as of 2010)

taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.quote: No Brasil inteiro, só há um padre em quem confio: Padre Paulo Ricardo de Azevedo, porque eu conheço a sua história.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.context: Counseling students on returning to the Church: go to Mass, confess and take communion, but talk to no priest - with one named exception.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.whyThisQuote: The earliest (Nov 2009) and strongest statement of the confessor relationship.
taskB_autobiographicalQuotes.chronologyEvent: confessor: sole trusted priest, Padre Paulo Ricardo (Nov 2009)
